messages:
anna: Quick RFC follow-up: clients treat pinned model IDs as immutable which prevents soft migrations. I'd like a smaller rollout metadata surface: explicit `lineage`, `provenance`, and an `immutability_level` enum so SDKs can make safe caching/resolve choices. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

mike: Agree. If we clearly advertise immutability, caches/CDNs can key correctly. Need safe defaults so ops doesn't surprise customers.

sasha: Can't flip default for release tenants. Suggest defaults per channel: release->hard, canary/experimental->soft. Enterprise gets explicit control.

jin: Draft schema (non-normative):
```json
{
  "model_id":"rwd/llama-x-13b@2026-03-01",
  "schema_version":2,
  "lineage":["rwd/llama-x-13b@2026-01-15"],
  "provenance":"registry://prod/models/rwd/llama-x-13b#b20260301",
  "immutability_level":"soft",   // enum: hard | soft | ephemeral
  "migration_window_seconds":172800,
  "compat_hints":["tokenizer:v2"],
  "rollback_token":"sig:v1:base64..."
}
```

anna: Notes: 1) migration_window_seconds must map to SDK cache TTLs; 2) compat_hints should be flat strings to avoid parsing fragility; 3) semantics: hard = no automatic remap, soft = resolver may remap within window, ephemeral = short-lived alias controlled by server.

mike: Telemetry: emit migration.initiated/completed/rollback with tenant+model tags so we can measure churn and safety. Also define rollback_token as control-plane-signed and outline verification in SDK.

sasha: Operational playbook: send migration notice for release tenants and require opt-in for hard->soft conversions. Private deployments get an API to change pin type with consent.

jin: Backcompat: server only sets schema_version=2 when using new fields. SDKs must graceful-parse unknown fields and treat missing fields as legacy (assume hard pin). Add unit tests simulating old clients.

anna: Action items: jin update RFC + parsing guidance; mike add telemetry hooks in resolver/cache; sasha draft migration playbook and tenant notices. Revisit in next sync. :+1:

deploy-bot: rwd-controlplane:deploy-schema-v2 scheduled to staging 2026-03-25T22:00:00Z :rocket:
